text:
The current failures (phase margin and CMRR) look fixable by retuning parameters, so I'm choosing a guided refine rather than a rewrite.

- **Phase margin:** The amplifier is unstable at −21° phase margin. The measured UGBW is 1.9× my prediction, which points to complex-pole peaking from the indirect compensation. Phase margin is very sensitive to gmid1, and helped by raising gmid7. So I'll back off gmid1, push gmid7 up, and widen the Cc range so the search can trade some UGBW for damping. UGBW currently has 2× margin to spend.
- **CMRR:** It is 7 dB short. The tail transistor M5 has a low gm/gds of 92, so I'll lengthen it (Lb toward 3). I'll also raise the PMOS mirror gm/Id (gmidp) to increase mirror gm.
- **Settling:** It shows n/a, most likely because the circuit is unstable, so it should recover once phase margin is fixed.
